name: Relational property
description: Relational qualities hold between two or more entities rather than inhering in one. The example is a mass proportion relating a portion of iron to a metal sheet with a magnitude of 97.7 mass-%, expressed through a fraction value specification.
competency_questions: Which quality holds between two entities rather than inhering in one? Which entities does a relational quality relate? What fraction value and unit express a mass proportion?
